My research has developed through three overlapping emphases. Each adds methods and perspective to the work that came before.

## A connected research trajectory

<div class="trajectory-ribbon"><article><p class="eyebrow">01 · Measure & map</p><h3>Environmental quality, water resources & spatial risk</h3><p>Groundwater and water quality → GIS and geostatistics → understanding spatial environmental risk.</p><p class="phase-foundation">Measurement &amp; mapping</p></article><article><p class="eyebrow">02 · Adapt & connect</p><h3>Climate adaptation, resilience & science–policy</h3><p>Climate adaptation → community and institutional practice → connecting evidence with implementation.</p><p class="phase-foundation">Measurement &amp; mapping + adaptation practice</p></article><article><p class="eyebrow">03 · Predict & decide</p><h3>Precision conservation & resilient agricultural landscapes</h3><p>Watershed monitoring and modelling → machine learning → conservation planning → adaptive decision support.</p><p class="phase-foundation">Measurement &amp; mapping + adaptation practice + modelling</p></article></div>

<p class="common-thread"><strong>Common thread:</strong> environmental evidence → spatial understanding → better decisions.</p>
